scope: read-only source-resolution review; no compiler invocation, adopted naming target or native qualification
observations: Catalog preparation selects modules by exact module ID.
Catalog::record matches a qualified SQL source against module namespace and authored Record name; module name is not used.
application_resolve passes source namespace and name to Catalog::record.
Multiple matching Records yield WFT-NAME-AMBIGUOUS; selecting both original catalog documents does not create a document-qualified SQL source.
disposition: No module-name addition is required by these reviewed source-resolution paths. Record/Field authoring remains a proposal; global naming policy remains pending.
